
Cf. vraag van opdrachtgever om de eDNA-data zeker mee te nemen.

Er is voor gekozen om de workflow op de punten waar dat toe doet (i.e. Natura2000-indices + Verspreidingskaart) hier te hernemen, i.p.v. de verbeterde data in de vorige dataflows op te nemen.

```{r prep packages}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(vecsets)
library(colorRamps) # for continuous-scale plots (Matlab-like)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
# ensure to have these loaded from 3_bezetting_VL.Rmd
ias.cube.raw

map.flan.clean
map.prov.clean
map.flan.grid

map.VRL.clean
map.HRL.clean

eea_cells
map.N2K.grid
map.VRL.grid
map.HRL.grid
```

```{r old data}
old <- ias.cube.raw %>%
  filter(specieskey == "Misgurnus mohoity")
```

```{r extra data}
# verleend door Rein Brys, as of 2026-05-12
gendf <- "./prius2/input/posthoc_misgurnus/eDNA_AMK_Vlaanderen_asof26-05-12.xlsx"

# 2024
new24 <- read_excel(gendf, sheet = 1) %>% 
  filter(positief == 1) %>% 
  st_as_sf(wkt = "WKT", crs = 4326)

ggplot() + geom_sf(data = new24)

# 2025 - no positive detections !
# new25 <- read_excel(gendf, sheet = 2)
```

```{r extra data grid}
# unique grid cells
join1 <- st_join(new24, map.flan.grid)

join2 <- st_join(map.flan.grid, new24) %>% 
  filter(positief == 1)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = join2) +
  geom_sf(data = new24)

```
